title: SNAPKART
summary: Shopping starts with exploration, but checkout needs clarity. SnapKart explores a connected mobile journey from recommendations and search to product options, payment review, and order confirmation. The design keeps the next action visible as the shopper moves through each step.

attrs.alt: SnapKart final home screen with recommendations, deals, and interests

children: Recommendations, deals, interests, and search provide several ways into the catalog. Product details and checkout then bring the information needed for a purchase decision into focus.
A connected prototype carries the journey through to an explicit order-confirmation state.

From wireframes to the final interaction

The wireframes establish the shopping hierarchy before the visual exploration adds product imagery, serif headlines, and warm accents. Shared cards and controls carry that visual language through the screens.

attrs.alt: SnapKart product details and purchase options

children: The result is a connected set of shopping screens and prototype states, supported by reusable components. The design makes discovery exploratory and payment more structured. Product selection and checkout comprehension would be the next areas to validate with shoppers.
